params.body:
The Hoet-design token expired on 2026-09-11 and nothing said so: every measurement that read GitHub for Hoet, Cabrio and the two mirrors came back as "GitHub did not answer" for a day, which reads like a hiccup and not like a key that stopped working. A fine-grained token carries its own expiry in every answer (`github-authentication-token-expiration`), so the answer to "when does this stop" was one request away and never asked.

`credentials` (cheap, days, availability, daily): per project's owner, one request with the token Elixir reads with (who am I, until when) and one with the copy the gateway pushes with (`control/github-token-<owner>`), compared by digest and never shown. Facts: valid, expiresAt and daysLeft (absent when the token never expires), and whether the two copies are one token. Refused is measured, not a blind spot: it is the one thing this scan exists to say.

Portal's card is abovebeyond-ai/portal#258. Tests in `CredentialsScanTest`. Suite 547 green, PHPStan green.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: De meting credentials: een sleutel die verloopt zegt wanneer
